answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the sonnet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the violet of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
